mapper.select: SELECT a.playerNo, a.playerNm, COUNT(loser) FROM BATGERS_PLAYER_LIST AS a LEFT JOIN BATGERS_MATCH_CHILD AS b ON a.playerNo = b.loser GROUP BY loser HAVING COUNT(loser) >= 0 ORDER BY playerNo

SELECT pl.playerNo, pl.playerNm, COALESCE(s.matchCnt, 0) AS matchCnt, COALESCE(s.gameCnt, 0) AS gameCnt, COALESCE(s.defeatCnt, 0) AS defeatCnt, COALESCE(s.absoluteDefeatCnt, 0) AS absoluteDefeatCnt, COALESCE(s.fee, 0) AS fee, ROUND(pl.rating) AS rating, ROUND(GREATEST(0, pl.rating - 1050) / 2) AS penalty FROM BATGERS_PLAYER_LIST pl LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.playerNo, COUNT(DISTINCT s.parentCd) AS matchCnt, SUM(s.gameCnt) AS gameCnt, SUM(GREATEST(0, s.absoluteDefeatCnt - x.minDefeatCnt)) AS defeatCnt, SUM(s.absoluteDefeatCnt) AS absoluteDefeatCnt, SUM(s.bet * (x.totalDefeatCnt - x.playerCnt * s.absoluteDefeatCnt)) AS fee FROM (SELECT parentCd, playerNo, MAX(bet) AS bet, COUNT(*) AS gameCnt, SUM(absoluteDefeatCnt) AS absoluteDefeatCnt FROM VW_MATCH_PLAYER_GAME_STAT WHERE 1 = 1
AND gameCd = 1
AND gameCd != 1
AND regDate >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ${dateRange} MONTH)
GROUP BY parentCd, playerNo) s INNER JOIN (SELECT parentCd, MIN(absoluteDefeatCnt) AS minDefeatCnt, SUM(absoluteDefeatCnt) AS totalDefeatCnt, COUNT(*) AS playerCnt FROM (SELECT parentCd, playerNo, SUM(absoluteDefeatCnt) AS absoluteDefeatCnt FROM VW_MATCH_PLAYER_GAME_STAT WHERE 1 = 1
AND gameCd = 1
AND gameCd != 1
AND regDate >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL ${dateRange} MONTH)
GROUP BY parentCd, playerNo) a GROUP BY parentCd) x ON x.parentCd = s.parentCd GROUP BY s.playerNo) s ON s.playerNo = pl.playerNo
